longTitle.officialTitle: To amend the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to expand access to capital for rural-area small businesses, and for other purposes.

enactingFormula.i: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representa­tives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Expanding Access to Capital for Rural Job Creators Act”.

section.heading: ACCESS TO CAPITAL FOR RURAL-AREA SMALL BUSINESSES.
section.chapeau: Section 4(j) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78d(j)) is amended—

paragraph.content: in paragraph (4)(C), by inserting “, rural-area small businesses” after “women-owned small businesses”; and
in paragraph (6)(B)(iii), by inserting “, rural-area small businesses” after “women-owned small businesses”.

signature.role: Speaker of the House of Representatives.
Vice President of the United States and President of the Senate.
